title: Erstes Urteil gegen zwei Männer nach Schüssen in der Ebersstraße

extraction.summaryEn: Court convicted two men on 10 November 2026 of attempted manslaughter over a March 2026 shooting of a 38-year-old man in Schöneberg; a third defendant was acquitted and the verdict is not yet final. The shooting itself injured the victim, who was not in mortal danger.
